questions.a: Forces equal in size and opposite in direction; net force zero, so the state of motion does not change.

questions.q: What happens when forces are unbalanced?
questions.a: The object accelerates in the direction of the net force - it starts, stops or changes motion.

questions.q: A book rests on a table. Name the balanced forces on it.
questions.a: Its weight downward and the table's normal reaction upward.

concepts.title: Newton's Laws of Motion and Inertia

questions.q: A 4 kg block accelerates at 3 m/s2. Find the applied force.
A 0.2 kg ball accelerates at 50 m/s2. Calculate the force.
What force accelerates a 2500 kg truck at 0.4 m/s2?
Find the force that gives a 12 kg cart an acceleration of 5 m/s2.
A 1.5 kg book is pushed so that it speeds up at 4 m/s2. Compute the force.
State Newton's third law of motion.
questions.a: Every action has an equal and opposite reaction, acting on different bodies.

questions.q: Why does a gun recoil when fired?
questions.a: The forward push on the bullet has an equal backward push on the gun.

questions.q: How does a rocket move upward?
questions.a: Hot gases rush down; the equal and opposite reaction pushes the rocket up.
